description: This file defines the IGrainLocator interface used for locating and managing grain activation addresses within an Orleans cluster. It includes methods for registration, deregistration, lookup, cache update, cache invalidation, and cache lookup operations related to grain addresses.

classes.name: IGrainLocator
classes.description: Interface for locating grain activation addresses within an Orleans cluster, providing methods for registration, deregistration, lookup, cache management, and cache querying.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address in the directory and returns the registered address.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Deregisters a grain address from the directory.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Finds the address for a given grain id, returning null if not registered.

methods.name: UpdateCache
methods.description: Updates the cache with a grain placement decision or activation address.

methods.name: InvalidateCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries associated with a specific grain id.

methods.name: InvalidateCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries associated with a specific grain address.

methods.name: TryLookupInCache
methods.description: Attempts to find a grain address in the local cache for a given grain id.
